tm.overview: When aspiring model Jesse moves to Los Angeles, her youth and vitality are devoured by a group of beauty-obsessed women who will take any means necessary to get what she has.

https://www.mymovies.it/film/2016/theneo.syn: From the director of Drive and Only God Forgives, an original film that combines drama with horror.

tm.title: A Child Is Waiting
tm.overview: Dr. Matthew Clark is the head of a state institution for intellectually disabled children. Jean Hansen, a former music teacher anxious to give her life some meaning, joins the staff of the hospital. Jean, who tries to shelter the children with her love, suspiciously regards Dr. Clark's stern training methods. She becomes emotionally involved with 12-year-old Reuben Widdicombe, who has been abandoned by his divorced parents.

https://www.mymovies.it/film/1963/gli-es.syn: Dr. Matthew Clark is the head of a state institution for intellectually disabled children.

tm.overview: Stray Kids bring their World Tour (RUN IT) concert to cinemas in a live broadcast, with all eight members performing their high-energy choreography.

tm.title: Invasion of the Body Snatchers
tm.overview: A small-town doctor learns that the population of his community is being replaced by emotionless alien duplicates.

https://www.mymovies.it/film/1956/linvas.syn: Many beings are prey to extraterrestrial forces that deprive them of soul and mind, leaving their bodies as empty shells.

mm.plot_it: Anno Duemila: un'astronave che viaggia alla velocità della luce arriva sul pianeta Altair dominato da un folle terrestre che crea mostri suscitati dal proprio inconscio e da un automa.

tm.title: Forbidden Planet
tm.overview: Starship C57D travels to planet Altair 4 in search of the crew of spaceship "Bellerophon," a scientific expedition that has been missing for twenty years. They find themselves unwelcome by the expedition's lone survivor and warned of destruction by an invisible force if they don't turn back immediately.

https://www.mymovies.it/film/1956/il-pia.syn: Year 2000: a spaceship traveling at the speed of light arrives on the planet Altair dominated by a terrestrial madman who creates monsters aroused by his unconscious and by an automaton.
